pr_title: Hide resume overlay when re-pausing gameplay
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/6442.

Added a way to cancel the resume overlay if the user is pausing while the overlay is active.
pr_comments: I suppose it could be nice to have some visual tests here too.
@nwabear Please refrain from constantly merging the upstream master branch into your branch unless you need that.
